finding.summary: This is wrong. It should be `restart_policy=(host_config.get('RestartPolicy') or dict()).get('Name')`. But it's better to store `host_config.get('RestartPolicy') or dict()` into a new variable before, since you need to reuse it below.

label: real_issue
label_reason: A human reviewer raised this in ansible/ansible#66192 (merged 2020-01-06), and a later commit in the PR changes the file.
notes: Hand-picked with Claude Code (PMAT-310): https://github.com/ansible/ansible/pull/66192. Python: passes the whole RestartPolicy dict where the name is expected. Human reviewers are not perfect ground truth, and they give no severity, so any severity counts.
